Activist Detained in Delhi, Alleges Abuse in Custody

Activist Neha Bora was detained by Delhi Police and subsequently released. Following her release, Bora alleged that she was subjected to abuse while in custody, including being kicked in the private parts. The details surrounding her detention and the specific reasons for it are not fully elaborated in the provided coverage, but the AISA (All India Students' Association) is mentioned in relation to her release and future actions.
